There is so much to discover here, take a walk around the villages, get yourself acquainted with people and culture. Head to the lake, sit by the side or go for a stroll.
how_to_reach: Jolarpettai Junction railway station, about 20 km away
practical_notes: Check locally for current timings, entry conditions, and seasonal access before visiting.

name: Yelagiri Lake
description: Take a stroll on the banks of a stunning lake with your loved ones. It would calm your mind and body like anything! Punganoor Lake is an amazing lake situated in the middle of the Yelagiri Hills in Tamil Nadu, 1 km away from Athanavur Bus Stop.
how_to_reach: Jolarpettai Junction railway station, about 20 km away
practical_notes: Check locally for current timings, entry conditions, and seasonal access before visiting.

name: Sanjeevi Hills
description: Sanjeevi hills is one of the enticing hillocks in Tamil Nadu that has an air of tranquillity about it. Sanjeevi hills is located at Rajapalayam in Virudhunagar district of Tamil Nadu that has a fair share of historical and religious significance attached to it.
how_to_reach: Rajapalayam has a good road connectivity. It is easily accessible by road.
practical_notes: Check locally for current timings, entry conditions, and seasonal access before visiting.
